result.topic_en: Riemann restricts the variables x, y to a bounded surface T spread over the plane A. He argues that the boundary determines the number of overlapping sheets at each point, because crossing the boundary from outside to inside raises the count by 1 and crossing the other way lowers it by 1. He then considers how sheets continue along both banks of a line l.
